notes: Prepared on 29 Oct 2026 before the grid landed; confirm the spectrum count, axes, units and copy on arrival. Bibcode from knowledge, not checked. Its lowest-gravity models hold about 0.4-0.65 of sigma*T^4 in SVO's raw files (source_evidence/grids/bt-cond/btsettl_raw_gravity/), so it may need the same bolometric_exceptions as bt-cond. An older SED_Tools lookup of this grid dropped minus signs on whole-number [M/H]: the guard's check 3 catches that.
